acs.text_first_line: AC1 The chart deploys the service and a worker on rwb-comms
AC2 The 16:00 Schedule is the only clock of the service
AC3 The Airflow WIN file window hands off to the run by business date
AC4 The consumer groups and the outbox relay are provisioned
AC5 The dashboards carry the dispatch, acknowledgement and proof series
AC6 The three operator alerts fire with a message ID and one runbook entry
AC7 The runbook reruns JOB-10 by business date without a second file
AC8 The smoke profile exercises the loop against the fakes
AC9 Rollback and the feature switch are safe
